weeks.content:
cat and hat, sun and fun
Pick the word that rhymes

big and small, up and down
Match the opposites

head, hand, eye, ear, leg
Label the body picture

mummy, daddy, sister, brother
Draw and label my family

desk, chair, book, board
Label our classroom

red, blue, one, two, three
Read the colour cards

I can see a big bus.
Read together and alone

what, where, who
Ask each other little questions

Read the class story together
Point to words we know

Read a page on my own
Reading certificate for all
